legacyChecks: concurrent identical command commits one observation and one receipt; replay preserves identity
same command and same source reject conflicting payloads without a second write
fixed evidence version and actual Unicode code-point windows; current and clipped reads have separate receipts
foreign/missing records conceal bodies and receipts; version mismatch is explicit
invalid ranges and privilege fields fail; an owner client cannot be reused inside a Work execution
deferred PostgreSQL commit failure rolls back writes and read receipts without returning evidence; the same command safely recovers
real valid Work/run/token ingestion commits its audit; stale token is fenced; failed audit rolls back observation and sequence before retry
real pg_locks barriers prove UPDATE and DELETE wait for the source share lock until the evidence receipt commits

g3Groups.name: T3 public owner commands, exact current dependencies and atomic revision loop
checks: concurrent candidate command replay, payload conflict and competing review CAS use public owner commands
real task capture and explicit bind preserve exact sources; correction invalidates old sources, owner rebind restores the actual business action gate
proposal reject restores source eligibility, accept replaces it, logical current follows successors, historical receipts remain distinct and owner-isolated
a real synthetic active Work/run/lease cannot acquire owner commands or owner current reads by passing its user ID
revoked actual Work source grants retain denied priority, withhold dependency bodies and block the real task action even during owner inspection
source-change ledger and public command receipt faults roll back memory retirement/replacement, raw assertion, review and receipt; the original command safely retries
memory/dependency current reads reject receipt faults without claiming an unaudited successful read
legacy in-place upsert adds one deterministic exact-version change ledger, invalidates the real dependent gate, skips unchanged replay, and rolls back source plus ledger on failure
limits: recorded dependency edges do not prove completeness
no external action or real user data
history outcomes do not establish current business state

g3Groups.name: T4 owner discovery, finalized recall and original evidence
checks: owner discovery pages saved memories including other scenes and history with exact versions, discovery-only semantics and owner-isolated durable receipts
public discovery/recall reject caller-supplied authority and out-of-budget requests
recall separates exact current state, raw historical evidence, saved interpretations, constraints and open questions without activating candidates
fixed original evidence uses the actual Unicode range and remains owner-isolated
real feedback freezes the final admission context and selected versions, retries once and rejects changed or foreign associations

trusted Work coordinator uses the saved scenario; real audited governance grant/revoke calls serialize with final admission under pg_locks barriers, revoke removes old selection and stale tokens cannot finalize
the real dispatch guard rechecks the registered selected versions before each logical request; revoke and final audit failure both reject with no new admission receipt or external model call
the identical public recall request reads the committed correction rather than an old cached interpretation
discovery/recall do not return a successful body when the durable query receipt fails; a fresh read recovers
a failed final admission audit never returns the earlier prepared context as a successful recall
quality inspection remains readonly, aggregate and explicitly unobserved where appropriate; review synchronization is a separate owner maintenance command
pg_locks barriers prove discovery source versions and its durable receipt commit before a competing real revision; the next exact current read changes version
insufficient budget for the complete selected safety constraints returns explicit unavailable rather than silently dropping their text

Independent observation body/version changes block later dispatch even when its parent remains readable history
The real exact snapshot window reader registers ssrv1; same-ID content replacement cannot silently refresh an old transcript proof
The actual platform-record SQL gateway compares its published physical projection, registers all three source versions and rejects Work use of owner-only projections
Actual grant revocation blocks an independently read cross-Work canonical source without owner-wide fallback
Actual owner canonical inspection registers candidate versions; expiry prevents later model consumption
Current saved Work binding is SHARE-checked again; changing binding blocks a previously read unchanged snapshot before the next provider call
Cross-Work grants do not override saved scenario binding; unsupported runtimes withhold exact snapshot bodies before returning a tool result
A real PG audit trigger failure causes zero local provider calls and no partial dispatch receipt

Actual Chat getMemoryArtifact reads private text without recall and registers a persisted evidence receipt; cleanup blocks its second Pi request, current-only receipt/foreign owner/Work capability/read-receipt failure cannot expose its body
limits: Local faux Pi transport only; no external model calls
Managed artifact text only; binary content, legacy workspace/RAG paths and independent domain/event sources are not implied to have these proofs
Permission lookup outage is injected at the DAO seam in unit tests; this PG helper tests real grant revocation without renaming shared tables

canonical.name: canonical batches: frozen plan, approval, atomic pages and receipts, pause, process continuation, idempotent retries, conflicts, concurrency and guarded rollback

g3Groups.name: T6 typed stored-source dispatch
checks: Actual platform source reader registers an unseen stored event; a physical body correction blocks the next Pi request
Owner chat history is read from the actual owned Chat/Message rows and cannot survive an unregistered cached history replacement
Actual Chat readonly RAG metadata then body uses two real representations without a false version conflict; changed chunks block later dispatch
Owner UI source windows have durable read receipts and exact full-version continuations; failed continuation leaves no successful receipt
Actual Work reader and stored-source authority share MCP leaf/case identities: prefixed allow permits one real request, prefixed mixed-case deny blocks initial admission and later dispatch
Actual registered Work reader uses a live lease and current explicit DB capability; runtime logging permits a next request, while actual denied configuration blocks it
An unchanged legacy Work memory expires by the post-lock clock; its later Pi request is blocked without pretending a new physical row revision occurred
Generic Work platform recall does not inherit owner raw capability, and unsupported runtimes fail before an unseen source body is returned
Managed artifact origin authority is checked for parsed RAG; cleaning the original blocks a previously read derivation without deleting its historical chunks
A real PG dispatch-audit failure prevents even local faux model consumption and leaves no partial successful read audit
limits: Local faux Pi only; no external model
Legacy local/cloud files and cached insight/rendered Work prose are explicit gaps, not imported by this check
Remote ledger and live external tools are observations at their recorded read time, not continuously current PostgreSQL facts

g3Groups.name: T6 RAG origin authority and representation identities
checks: real metadata listing then bounded text read coexist without overwriting either proof
same-owner active artifact manifest and full ref are part of native RAG source authority/version
artifact cleanup blocks fresh parsed reads and later dispatch, retaining the RAG record itself
a foreign artifact mapping never grants owner authority; active manifest ref changes invalidate old RAG use
unmapped legacy parsed text is independent owner data, never a verified or retractable original binary
correction of a legacy saved RAG chunk blocks the previous source proof before another dispatch

g3Groups.name: T7 registered local file snapshots
checks: Actual owned Chat plus no-link bounded FD import produces a durable immutable snapshot; foreign task, traversal, junction and hardlink are refused
Actual owner file-source read with stored cached body publishes content:null and file_source_descriptor.v1 refs; current descriptor restores only as configuration, never a physical body proof
A synthetic legacy receipt cloned from that actual owned policy/full revision with only representation removed can prepare, but admission fails without a new receipt or cached body authorization
Actual Work Read and runtime audit permit a next request; original workspace changes do not falsify imported_snapshot current semantics
Explicit reimport creates an independent immutable version and owner CAS rebind blocks the older transcript proof
A physical managed-object mutation blocks the next actual faux Pi request before another provider call
Real owner revoke, normalized current tool deny and unchanged-row TTL each block previously read Work file context
Actual separately granted converter saves a new managed Markdown artifact with the bound source version and evidence receipt lineage
Actual admission-audit failure rolls back artifact evidence receipt and Work event writes; no model body escapes
Owner Chat artifact reads also rehash actual managed bytes per request; owner cleanup invalidates the formal Work binding
limits: Imported snapshots are independent versions, not arbitrary filesystem grants or claims that originals remain current
Local faux Pi only; no real model
Edit of original inputs and unisolated shell remain denied

g3Groups.name: checkMemoryModuleT7Plans
checks: Generated plan captures the actual source receipt plus a separate immutable owner input; retries are stable and changed payloads conflict
Real PG approval/receipt failure is atomic; restored receipts admit the actual Pi request, and corrected sources block the next request and approval replay
Expired legacy row is preserved; explicit owner rebase records unknown historical sources, excludes cached prompt, and current plan revocation blocks a later request
Chat deletion remains available and invalidates its approved plan before another provider request; owner deletion cascades plan commands without FK obstruction
A full existing dispatch registry rolls back approval, execution claim and every new source audit; the displayed proposal remains ready
An unchanged approved plan expires on the actual post-lock clock and cannot issue its next provider request
